ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF SEPTEMBER 13, 2016
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of September 13, 2016.
A-1 Minutes 9-13-16 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL â€“ None
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
UPDATE AND PRESENTATION ON CRIME STATISTICS AND "BUILD -A-BIKE" PROGRAM BY THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the update.
C-1 Crime Statistics Update Staff Report
C-2
PRESENTATION AND DISCUSSION REGARDING PROPERTY ASSESSED CLEAN ENERGY ("PACE") FINANCING PROGRAMS IN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE (COUNCIL MEMBER ARGUDO)
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the report.
C-2 Ygrene and Hero Programs Staff Report
C-2 Ygrene and Hero Programs Attachment A County Motion
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1415
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 16-5304 approving Warrant Register No. 1415.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1415
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ESTABLISHING THE CITY COUNCIL'S 2017 REGULAR MEETING SCHEDULE
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 16-5305 establishing the 2017 City Council regular meeting schedule.
D-2 2017 Council Meeting Schedule Staff Report
D-2 2017 Council Meeting Schedule Resolution
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 14-5153 AND ADOPTING AN AMENDED CONFLICT OF INTEREST CODE FOR THE CITY OF LA PUENTE CONTAINING REVISED DESIGNATED POSITIONS AND DISCLOSURE CATEGORIES
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) receive and file the Local Agency Biennial Notice; and (2) adopt Resolution No. 16-5306 rescinding Resolution No. 14-5153 amending the Conflict of Interest Code for the City of La Puente.
D-3 Conflict of Interest Code Staff Report
D-3 Conflict of Interest Code Attachment A Notice
D-3 Conflict of Interest Code Attachment B Resolution
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT, INC. FOR TRAFFIC DETOUR AND CONTROL SERVICES FOR CITY COMMUNITY EVENTS IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $80,000.00
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the amendment to the agreement with Traffic Management, Inc. for traffic detour and control services for City community events; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment on behalf of the City.
D-4 TMI Amendment Staff Report
D-4 TMI Amendment Attachment A Amendment
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF AN AMENDED AND RESTATED SETTLEMENT AND RELEASE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND JOSE GUTIERREZ FOR THE UNRUH AVENUE SPECIFIC PLAN AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF A SENIOR HOUSING PROJECT LOCATED AT 1040 UNRUH AVENUE
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Amended and Restated Settlement and Release Agreement between the City and Jose Gutierrez; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-5 Gutierrez Amendment Staff Report
D-5 Gutierrez Amendment Attachment A Original Agreement
D-5 Gutierrez Amendment Attachment B Amended Agreement
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ACCEPTING AN IRREVOCABLE OFFER OF DEDICATION OF EASEMENT FOR ROAD PURPOSES AT THE INTERSECTION OF SUNSET AND NELSON AVENUES IN THE CITY
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 16-5308 accepting an easement for road purposes at the intersection of Sunset and Nelson Avenues.
D-6 Sunset Ave Acceptance of Easement Staff Report
D-6 Sunset Ave Acceptance of Easement Attachment A Resolution
D-7
CONSIDERATION OF A LICENSE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE AND JULIAN BLANDINO FOR THE USE OF CITY PROPERTY LOCATED AT THE INTERSECTION OF VALLEY BOULEVARD AND OLD VALLEY BOULEVARD
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the License Agreement between the City of La Puente and Julian Blandino; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-7 License Agreement Blandino Staff Report
D-7 License Agreement Blandino Attachment A Agreement
D-8
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE TECH SHIRTS FROM GILLMAN SURGE, LLC, FOR THE CITY OF LA PUENTE'S ANNUAL MAIN STREET HALLOWEEN RUN IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $20,500
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the purchase with Gilman Surge, LLC, Inc. in an amount not to exceed $20,500 and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the purchase order on behalf of the City.
D-8 Main Street Run Shirts Staff Report
D-8 Main Street Run Shirts Attachment A Proposal
D-9
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING CLOSING CITY HALL AND OTHER CITY FACILITIES THE FULL DAY ON FRIDAY, DECEMBER 23, 2016
It is recommended that the City Council support the closure of all City facilities for the full day on December 23, 2016.
D-9 City Facilities Holiday Closure Staff Report
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION NO. 16-5307 ADOPTING THE REVISED COUNCIL POLICY CC-2.1, TRAVEL EXPENSE REIMBURSEMENT AND RESCINDING RESOLUTION 12-5032
It is recommended that the City Council approve the changes to Council Policy CC-2.1, Travel Expense Reimbursement by approving and adopting Resolution No. 16-5307.
E-2 Travel Expense Reimbursement Staff Report
E-2 Travel Expense Reimbursement Policy Attachment A Redline
E-2 Travel Expense Reimbursement Policy Attachment B Resolution 2
E-2 Travel Expense Reimbursement Policy Attachment C Summary

AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
